program.chef: Agreed 36 × 66-inch island working footprint; chef stands on range-facing edge. Placement remains subject to full-room fit.

program.compost: Portable bowl beyond the board among washed produce; no dedicated cabinet requested.
program.helper: Separate useful board and landing, outside chef-to-heat movement.
program.guests: Four remains requested; three is an explicitly invited alternative. No decision to reduce the requirement. Angled inward end seats and 24-inch guest/18-inch helper surface depths are tests.
program.cleanup: Protect full daily cleanup capacity: dirty landing/scraping, sink, right-side dishwasher, clean drying/unloading and storage access. Existing bent run is the functional benchmark. Fixed wall cannot rely on outward expansion. Do not truncate to 65-inch sink/DW-only row to accommodate entertaining.
program.table: Normal extension and table/window relationship stay fixed.
program.routes: Table through range aisle and Butler's pantry to formal dining. Occasional traffic during cooking, mainly serving/entertaining. Secondary approach outside kitchen through hall is less friendly, not an outdoor route or accepted primary substitute.
program.porch: Former screened porch to be integrated by opening its wall for some breakfast/beverage functions. This is distinct from fixed cleanup wall. Detailed porch design deferred.
program.buffet: Stage buffet while guests remain at perch, without clearing perch. At most 20 uses yearly. Lower helper run is preferred candidate; integrated porch transition and temporary/drop-down surfaces remain alternatives.
program.M5: Orthogonal to kitchen axes: French-door plane parallel to cleanup, slider plane parallel to peninsula. Earlier inferred wall angles/trim locations and hypothetical French-door sweeps must not control decisions.
program.priorities: Daily cleanup and cooking outrank occasional buffet/hosting (about 15–20 times yearly). Perch and independent buffet staging remain separate needs; guest surface must adapt to a viable daily kitchen.
program.cleanup_workflow: Facing main sink: dirty dishes land left; rinse then load dishwasher right, or hand-wash and place in rack on countertop above dishwasher. Extra dirty dishes may stack on island. Island overflow is explicitly accepted, not an automatic layout failure; ordinary landing still belongs left of sink.
